tools.name: get_block_number
tools.description: Get the current latest block number on Base

tools.name: get_gas_price
tools.description: Get current gas price on Base

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get ETH balance of an address on Base

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Get transaction details by hash on Base

tools.name: get_address_label
tools.description: Get a human-readable label for an EVM address (100K+ entity labels: exchanges, bridges, protocols, scams). FREE, no payment required.

tools.name: get_usdc_balance
tools.description: Get USDC balance of an address on Base (stablecoin balance, more useful than ETH for most agents)

tools.name: explain_transaction_simple
tools.description: Explain a transaction in plain English: who sent what to whom, with address labels. FREE simplified version of our premium explain tool.

tools.name: search_labels_by_category
tools.description: Search all labeled addresses by category (e.g. exchange, bridge, protocol, scam). Returns up to 50 matches.

tools.name: get_transaction_receipt
tools.description: Get transaction receipt by hash: success/failure status, gas used, logs. Useful for checking if a tx succeeded.

tools.name: get_block_by_number
tools.description: Get block details by block number: timestamp, miner, transaction count, gas used.

tools.name: get_contract_logs
tools.description: Get event logs from a contract in a block range. Useful for tracking transfers, approvals, etc.

tools.name: estimate_gas
tools.description: Estimate gas needed for a transaction. Useful for dapps and wallets to show users how much gas they'll pay.

tools.name: get_contract_code
tools.description: Get contract bytecode at an address. Useful for checking if an address is a contract or a wallet.
